verdict.rationale: An auth framework could plausibly offer AI-generated insights on auth and user data, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows the product producing AI insights or suggestions from a user's data. The hosted MCP server only provides documentation search and setup help. The MCP plugin and the agent-auth features cover authorization for AI clients, not in-product analysis. The activity feed on the homepage shows plain event listings with no AI insight layer.
